### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `color`

color?: ColorInput | undefined

Stroke colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `dashPattern`

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

### `length`

```typescript
length?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `orientation`

```typescript
orientation?: LineOrientation | undefined
```

*optional*
